sentences.en: Traditionally, men were expected to take the lead in courtship.
sentences.zh: 传统上，男性被期望在求爱中扮演主导角色。

sentences.en: Their love was the result of a long courtship.
sentences.zh: 他们的爱情是经过一段长久的追求后产生的。

sentences.en: Courtships get interesting when one of the two plays hard to get.
sentences.zh: 当双方中的一方故意保持距离时，这段求爱就变得有趣了。

senses.zh: 求爱期，追求期,求爱，求婚,动求偶（现象）
